text: The create benchmark is the cargo project benchmarks/ on branch bench at efaf30f: cargo run --release -- [WHICH] [-t N] [-r N] [-s MiB] [--compare-to label=path]. The differential sweep is still untracked: tmp-claude/2026-11-02-refactor-survey/construct/sweep.sh diffs stdout, exit codes and .sufr bytes of two binaries over every fixture, mode and flag.
